title: No Support, No Firmness...(feels like no pillow is being used)
text:
No Support, No Firmness...(feels like no pillow is being used). The Dreamhood pillows arrive vacuum packed. Its recommended to wait 24 hours prior to the first use after removal from the packaging. They are definitely soft and plush...until they're actually used. The pillow doesn't provide any elevation, support or firmness; your head sinks right down to the mattress. Its as though no pillow is even being used.

My husband and I tried to get comfortable using the Dreamhoods with no luck. We wound up getting our old pillows out of the closet to use. I'll either place the Dreamhoods on the spare bed or ask a friend/relative if they want them. They're not the right pillows for us.
